getting-started-speaking-to-a-tower-guar.player: Hello. What are you doing here?

getting-started-speaking-to-a-tower-guar.speaker: Tower guard
getting-started-speaking-to-a-tower-guar.text: We are the tower guards – our business is our own!

getting-started-attempting-to-climb-the-.speaker: Tower guard
getting-started-attempting-to-climb-the-.text: You can't go up there. That's private, that is.

getting-started-speaking-to-a-wizard.speaker: Wizard
getting-started-speaking-to-a-wizard.text: You'll have to speak with the Watchtower Wizard about that.

getting-started-speaking-to-the-watchtow.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
getting-started-speaking-to-the-watchtow.text: Who are you? Are you one of the new guards?

getting-started-speaking-to-the-watchtow.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
getting-started-speaking-to-the-watchtow.text: Well what are you doing here?

getting-started-speaking-to-the-watchtow.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
getting-started-speaking-to-the-watchtow.text: Oh my, oh my! What does it all matter in the end, anyway?

steps.player: What's the matter?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Oh dear, oh dear. Darn and drat!

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: We try hard to keep this town protected.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: But how can we do that when the Watchtower isn't working?

steps.player: What do you mean it isn't working?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: The Watchtower here works by the power of magic. An ancient spell designed to ward off ogres that has been in place here for many moons.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: The exact knowledge of the spell is lost to us now, but the essence of the spell has been infused into four powering crystals that keep the tower protected from the hordes in the Feldips.

options.text: So how come the spell doesn't work?

steps.player: So how come the spell doesn't work?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: The crystals! The crystals have been taken!

steps.player: Taken?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Stolen!

steps.player: Stolen?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Yes, yes! Do I have to repeat myself?

steps.player: Can I be of help?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Help? Oh wonderful, dear traveller!

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Yes I could do with an extra pair of eyes here.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: There must be some evidence of what has happened here. Perhaps you could assist me in searching for clues?

steps.player: I would be happy to.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Try searching the surrounding area. If you find anything unusual, bring it here. Try the bushes - I've read enough adventure stories to know that clues get caught in bushes all the time.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: I will tell the guards to let you past - that way, you can just use the ladder to get in and out.

steps.player: I'm not interested.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: That's typical, nowadays. It's left to us wizards to do all the work.

options.text: I'm not interested in your rantings.

steps.player: I'm not interested in your rantings.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Hmph! Suit yourself.

steps.player: You wizards are always complaining.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Complaining? Complaining!

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: What folks these days don't realise is that if it weren't for us wizards, this entire world would be overrun with every creature you could possibly imagine. And some you couldn't even conceive of!

searching-for-evidence-speaking-to-a-wiz.player: I've got some questions about the search for evidence.

searching-for-evidence-speaking-to-a-wiz.speaker: Wizard
searching-for-evidence-speaking-to-a-wiz.text: You'll have to speak with the Watchtower Wizard about that.

searching-for-evidence-talking-to-the-wa.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
searching-for-evidence-talking-to-the-wa.text: Hello again. Did you find anything of interest?
With no evidence to show him:

steps.player: No, sorry, nothing yet.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Oh dear, oh dear, there must be something, somewhere...

searching-for-evidence-talking-to-the-wa.text: With any of the evidence besides fingernails:

steps.player: I have this [robe/dagger/armour/eyepatch]...

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Let me see...

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: No, sorry, this is not evidence. You need to keep searching, I'm afraid.

steps.player: Have a look at these...

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Interesting, very interesting.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Long nails...grey in colour...well chewed...

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Of course! They belong to a skavid!

steps.player: A skavid?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: A servant race to the ogres: grey, depressed-looking creatures, always losing nails, teeth and hair!

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: They inhabit the caves in the Feldip Hills.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: They normally keep to themselves, though. It's unusual for them to venture from their caves.

options.text: What do you suggest I do?

steps.player: What do you suggest I do?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: It's no good searching the caves. Well, not yet, anyway.

steps.player: Why not?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: They are deep and complex. The only way you will navigate the caves is to have a map or something.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: It may be that the ogres have one...

steps.player: And how do you know that?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Well... I don't.

steps.player: So what do I do?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: You need to be fearless and gain entrance to Gu'Tanoth, the city of the ogres, then find out how to navigate the caves.

steps.player: That sounds scary...

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Ogres are nasty creatures, yes. Only a strong warrior, and a clever one at that, can get the better of them.

steps.player: What do I need to do to get into the city?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: You'll need some way to make the guards let you in.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: You could start by checking out the ogre settlements around here. Tribal ogres often dislike their neighbours... In the meantime, I'll throw those fingernails out for you.

steps.player: I won't bother, then.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Won't bother? Won't bother!

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Perhaps this quest is too hard for you?

steps.player: Shall I search the caves?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: It's no good searching the caves. Well, not yet, anyway.

steps.player: Why not?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: They are deep and complex. The only way you will navigate the caves is to have a map or something.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: It may be that the ogres have one...

steps.player: And how do you know that?

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Well... I don't.

steps.player: Aha! A robe. This could be a clue...

steps.text: old robe

steps.player: Here's some armour; it could be evidence...

steps.text: unusual armour

steps.player: Aha, a dagger! I wonder if this is evidence...

steps.text: damaged dagger

steps.player: I've found an eye patch; I had better show this to the Watchtower Wizard.

steps.text: tattered eye patch

steps.player: What's this? Disgusting! Some fingernails. They may be a clue though... I'd better take them.

steps.text: Fingernails

searching-for-evidence-searching-the-bus.text: Searching the same bush after finding an item in it:

searching-for-evidence-searching-the-bus.player: I have already searched this place.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard.player: I've got some questions regarding the tribal ogres.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard.speaker: Wizard
ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard.text: You'll have to speak with the Watchtower Wizard about that.

options.text: I am having difficulty with the tribes.

steps.player: I am having difficulty with the tribes.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Talk to them face to face and don't show any fear. Make sure you are rested and well fed, and fight the good fight!

steps.player: I have everything under control.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Good, good! I will expect the crystals back shortly then...

options.text: I have lost something the ogres gave to me.

steps.player: I have lost something the ogres gave to me.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Oh, deary me! Well, there's nothing I can do about it. You will have to go back to them, I'm afraid.

ogre-investigations-toban.speaker: Toban
ogre-investigations-toban.text: What do you want, small t'ing?

options.text: I seek entrance to the city of ogres.

steps.player: I seek entrance to the city of ogres.

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Hahaha! You'll never get in there.

steps.player: I'll find a way, trust me.

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Bold words for a t'ing so small.

options.text: I could do something for you...

steps.player: I could do something for you...

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Hahaha! This creature t'inks it can help me! I would eat you now, but for your puny size.

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Prove to me your might: bring me the bones of an adult dragon to chew on, and I'll eat them, not you.

steps.player: Die, creature!

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Hahaha! It t'inks it's a match for Toban, does it?
Tobans hits and damages the player

ogre-investigations-toban-speaking-to-to.speaker: Toban
ogre-investigations-toban-speaking-to-to.text: Hahaha! Small t'ing returns. Did you bring the dragon bone?

steps.player: I don't have what you want.

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Then you shall get nothing from me!

steps.player: When I say I will get something, I get it!

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Hahaha! Small t'ing has done it. Toban is glad - take this...
The ogre gives you part of a statue.

ogre-investigations-toban-speaking-to-to.speaker: Toban
ogre-investigations-toban-speaking-to-to.text: The small t'ing returns; what do you want now?

steps.player: I seek another task.

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Have you arrived for dinner? Hahaha! Be gone, small t'ing!

options.text: I can't find the relic part you gave me.

steps.text: If the player has the relic part on them:

steps.player: I can't find the relic part you gave me.

steps.speaker: Toban
steps.text: Small t'ing, you lie to me! I always says that small t'ings are big trouble.
You find a stash of gold inside.

steps.player: I think I need a key of some sort.

options.text: I seek entrance to the city of ogres.

steps.player: I seek entrance to the city of ogres.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: You got no business there!

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Just a minute... Maybe if you did somet'ing for me, I might help you get in.

steps.player: What can I do to help an ogre?

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: South-east of here der is more ogres - the name of the chieftain is Toban. He stole gold from me and I want it back!

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Here is a key to the chest it's in. If you bring it here, I may reward you...

options.text: I have come to kill you.

steps.player: I have come to kill you!

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Kill me, eh? You shall be crushed. Guards!
An ogre attacks the player.

ogre-investigations-og-speaking-to-og-ag.speaker: Og
ogre-investigations-og-speaking-to-og-ag.text: Where my gold from dat dirty Toban?

steps.text: If the player does have the gold:

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Well, well, the little t'ing has got it! Take dis to show little t'ing is a friend to da ogres. Hahahahaha!
The ogre gives you part of a horrible statue.
If the player doesn't have the gold:

steps.player: I have your gold.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: No you don't! If you want to impress me, get da gold I asked for!

steps.player: I haven't got it yet.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Don't come back until you have it, unless you wanna be on tonight's menu!
If the player no longer has the key:

steps.player: I have lost the key!

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Stoopid! Take another and don't lose it!
If the player has the key on them:

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Oh yeah? What's dat den?

steps.player: Oh yeah, I've got it right here.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Stoopid!
If the player has the key stored somewhere:

steps.player: I have lost the key!

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Are you trying to trick me? I bet you got it stored somewhere. Humans always do that.

options.text: Do you have any other tasks for me?

steps.player: Do you have any other tasks for me?

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: No, I have no more tasks for you, now go away.

options.text: I have lost the relic part you gave me.

steps.text: If the player has the relic part on them:

steps.player: I have lost the relic part you gave me.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Are you blind? I can see you got it even from here!
If the player lost the relic part:

steps.player: I have lost the relic part you gave me.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Grrr, why do I bother? It's a good job I got another part.
If the relic part is stored somewhere:

steps.player: I have lost the relic part you gave me.

steps.speaker: Og
steps.text: Are you trying to trick me? I bet you got it stored somewhere. Humans always do that.

ogre-investigations-grew.speaker: Grew
ogre-investigations-grew.text: What do you want, little morsel? You would look good on my plate!

ogre-investigations-grew.player: I want to enter the city of ogres.

ogre-investigations-grew.speaker: Grew
ogre-investigations-grew.text: Hah! I should eat you instead!

options.text: Don't eat me; I can help you.

steps.player: Don't eat me; I can help you.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: What can a morsel like you do for me?

steps.player: I am a mighty adventurer, slayer of monsters and user of magic powers.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: Well, well, perhaps the morsel can help after all...

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: If you t'ink you're tough, find Gorad, my enemy to the south-east, and knock one of his teeth out! Heheheheh!

options.text: You will have to kill me first.

steps.player: You will have to kill me first.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: That's not tricky - guards!
An ogre attacks the player.

ogre-investigations-grew-speaking-to-gre.speaker: Grew
ogre-investigations-grew-speaking-to-gre.text: The morsel is back. Does it have our tooth for us?

steps.player: Err, I don't have it.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: Morsel, you dare to return without the tooth! Either you are stoopid, or wants to be eaten!

steps.player: I have it.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: That'll annoy Gorad lots! Heheheheh! Here's a token of my gratitude: some old gem I stole from Gorad, and an old part of a statue.
You get part of a horrible statue... and one of the crystals!

ogre-investigations-grew-facing-gorad.player: I've come to knock your teeth out!

ogre-investigations-grew-facing-gorad.speaker: Gorad
ogre-investigations-grew-facing-gorad.text: You shut your face! I smack you till you dead and sorry!

steps.text: He's dropped a tooth. You grab it quickly.

ogre-investigations-grew-speaking-to-gre.speaker: Grew
ogre-investigations-grew-speaking-to-gre.text: What are you doing here, morsel?

options.text: Can I do anything else for you?

steps.player: Can I do anything else for you?

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: I have nothing left for you but the cooking pot!

options.text: I've lost the relic part you gave me.

steps.text: If the player has the relic part on them:

steps.player: I've lost the relic part you gave me.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: You lie to me, morsel!
If the player doesn't have the relic part:

steps.player: I've lost the relic part you gave me.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: Stupid morsel, I have another. Take it and go now before I lose my temper.
If the relic part is stored somewhere:

steps.player: I've lost the relic part you gave me.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: You probably got it stored somewhere, morsel! Humans do that a lot.

options.text: I've lost the crystal you gave me.

steps.text: If the player has the crystal on them:

steps.player: I've lost the crystal you gave me.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: How dare you lie to me morsel! I will grind you up for my bread!
If the player doesn't have the crystal:

steps.player: I've lost the crystal you gave me.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: I suppose you want another? I suppose just this once I could give you my copy...
If the crystal is stored somewhere:

steps.player: I've lost the crystal you gave me.

steps.speaker: Grew
steps.text: You probably got it stored somewhere, morsel! Humans do that a lot.

steps.player: An ogre called Og gave me this...
An ogre called Grew gave me this...
An ogre called Toban gave me this...

ogre-investigations-assembling-the-relic.text: After handing in one relic part:

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Ah, it's part of an old ogre statue. I'll take that off you - it might come in handy if I can fix it up.

ogre-investigations-assembling-the-relic.text: After handing in two relic parts:

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Ah, it's more of that old ogre statue. I'll take this bit too.

ogre-investigations-assembling-the-relic.text: After handing in the third relic part:

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: It looks like you've brought me all the pieces of the relic. It is as I thought - a statue symbolising an ogre warrior of old.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Well, if you ever want to make friends with an ogre, this is the item to have! Now I'll try to assemble it...
The wizard gives you a complete statue.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard-.player: I've got some questions about the ogre city.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard-.speaker: Wizard
ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard-.text: You'll have to speak with the Watchtower Wizard about that.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-a-wizard-.player: I had a feeling you might say that.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.text: Ah, the warrior returns. Have you found a way into Gu'Tanoth yet?

ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.player: I can't get past the guards.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.text: Well, ogres dislike others apart from their own kind. What you need is some form of proof of friendship, something to trick them into believing you're their friend.

ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
ogre-investigations-talking-to-the-watch.text: Which shouldn't be too hard, considering their intelligence.

options.text: I have lost the relic you gave me.

steps.text: If the player has the relic in their inventory:

steps.player: I have lost the relic you gave me.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Have you gone mad? I can see you have it with you!
If the player lost the relic:

steps.player: I have lost the relic you gave me.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: What? Lost the relic? How careless! It's a good job I copied its design, then! You can take this copy instead - it's just as good.
The wizard gives you another statue.
If the player stored the relic somewhere:

steps.player: I have lost the relic you gave me.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: I imagine you've stored it somewhere. Go and see where you might have put it.

options.text: I will find my way in, no problem.

steps.player: I will find my way in, no problem.

steps.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
steps.text: Yes, I'm sure you will... Good luck!

entering-gu-tanoth-city-guard.text: If the player is not carrying the relic:

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: Stop, creature! Only ogres and their friends allowed in this city. Show me a sign of companionship, like a lost relic or somefing, and you may pass.

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: Until then, back to whence you came!
(The ogre guard pushes you back down the hill, stunning you and dealing 3 damage)

entering-gu-tanoth-city-guard.text: If the player is carrying the relic:

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: Well, what proof of friendship did you bring?

steps.player: I have a relic!

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: It's got the statue of Dalgroth. Welcome to Gu'Tanoth, friend of the ogres.

entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-wizard.player: I've made it into the ogre city!

entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-wizard.speaker: Wizard
entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-wizard.text: You'll have to speak with the Watchtower Wizard about that.

entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-wizard.player: It's like talking to a broken record.

entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-watcht.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-watcht.text: How are you doing with the ogres?

entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-watcht.player: I have gained entry to the city!
I still can't navigate the skavid caves.

entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-watcht.speaker: Watchtower Wizard
entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-watcht.text: You need a map of some kind... I bet one of the ogres has one.

entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-watcht.player: Okay thanks, I'll go and find out.

entering-gu-tanoth-ogre-guard.speaker: Ogre guard
entering-gu-tanoth-ogre-guard.text: Oi! Where do you think you are going? You are for the cooking pot!

options.text: But I am a friend to ogres...

steps.player: But I am a friend to ogres...

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: Prove it to us with a gift. Get us something from the market.

steps.player: Like what?

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: Surprise us...

options.text: Not if I can help it.

steps.player: Not if I can help it.

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: You can help by being tonight's dinner, or you can go away. Now, which shall it be?

steps.player: Okay, okay, I'm going.

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: Back to whence you came!
The guard attacks the player, who falls into the lava. Fade out/in. The player appears south of Gu'Tanoth and takes damage.

options.text: I tire of ogres; prepare to die!

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: Grrrrr!
The ogre guard attacks the player.

steps.player: Um... is there anything in my backpack that you'd want?

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: You didn't bring anything! Shove off!

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: Stop, creature! Oh it's you. Well, what have you got for us, then?

steps.player: How about this?

steps.text: You offer the guard a rock cake.

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: Well, well, look at this. My favourite: rock cake! Okay, we will let it through.

entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-southe.speaker: Ogre guard
entering-gu-tanoth-talking-to-the-southe.text: What do you want, small thing? Leave us alone!

entering-gu-tanoth-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Ogre guard
entering-gu-tanoth-crossing-the-bridge.text: Oi! Little thing. If you want to cross here, you must pay me 20 gold pieces first!

entering-gu-tanoth-crossing-the-bridge.player: You want me to give you 20 gold pieces to let me jump off a bridge?

entering-gu-tanoth-crossing-the-bridge.speaker: Ogre guard
entering-gu-tanoth-crossing-the-bridge.text: That's what I said, like it or lump it.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have 20 coins:

steps.player: Okay, I'll pay it.

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: A wise choice, little thing.

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: And where is your money? Grrrr! Do you want to get hurt or something?
If the player has 20 coins:

steps.player: Okay, I'll pay it.

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: A wise choice, little thing.
The player jumps over the gap.

steps.player: Phew! I just made it.
Forget it, I'm not paying.

steps.speaker: Ogre guard
steps.text: In that case you're not crossing.

entering-gu-tanoth-seeking-passage.speaker: City guard
entering-gu-tanoth-seeking-passage.text: Grrrr, what business you got here?

entering-gu-tanoth-seeking-passage.speaker: City guard
entering-gu-tanoth-seeking-passage.text: So what you want with me?

options.text: I am an ogre killer come to destroy you!

steps.player: I am an ogre killer come to destroy you!

steps.speaker: City guard
steps.text: I would like to see you try!
You are under attack!

options.text: I seek passage into the skavid caves

steps.player: I seek passage into the skavid caves.

steps.speaker: City guard
steps.text: Is that so... You humour me small t'ing. Answer this riddle and I will help you...

steps.speaker: City guard
steps.text: I want you to bring me an item: I will give you all the letters of this item, you work out what it is...

steps.speaker: City guard
steps.text: My first is in days, but not in years, My second is in evil, and also in tears, My third is in all, but not in none, My fourth is in hot, but not in sun.

steps.speaker: City guard
steps.text: My fifth is in heaven, and also in hate, My sixth is in fearing, but not in fate, My seventh is in plush, but not in place.

steps.speaker: City guard
steps.text: My eighth is in nine, but not in eight, My last is in earth, and also in great.

steps.speaker: City guard
